visualCharacteristics: Thin full-width lead-capture bar with a solid accent background. Promo text on the left, a mobile-number input, and an 'Open Trading A/C' CTA button aligned in a single row.
contentPattern: First row = block name. Second row split into cells: promo text cell, mobile-number field cell (plain text becomes an input), and CTA link cell.
usage: Inline lead-capture / account-opening promo bar. Reused directly beneath the hero and again near the page footer.
